name: Gestures
description: Touchpad gestures: three fingers slide between workspaces, four resize the focused window, and every swipe and pinch maps to a window action from a panel. Shown in the bar on machines with a touchpad. Ported from omagesture

enabled.description: Gestures enabled. Off removes every mapped swipe and pinch; the touchpad tuning still applies.

naturalScroll.description: Natural scrolling on the touchpad and the mouse: content follows the fingers.

clickMethod.description: Click method (one of: clickfinger, buttonareas). clickfinger: two fingers anywhere is a right click, three a middle click. buttonareas: the bottom-right corner is the right button.

drag.description: Multi-finger drag (one of: off, threefinger, fourfinger). Dropped while swipes of the same finger count are mapped: libinput gives the fingers to one of the two.

middleButton.description: Middle click, a three-finger click under clickfinger (one of: none, resize, move, screenshot). move and resize turn a three-finger press-and-drag into window handling; any value but none takes middle click away from applications.

swipeRange.description: Workspace swipe reaches (one of: numbered, existing). numbered keeps going to empty workspaces by number; existing is Hyprland's default and stops one past the last open workspace.

swipeForever.description: Keep swiping without lifting: one continuous motion crosses several workspaces.

g2PinchIn.description: Two fingers, pinch in (one of: none, workspace, special, fullscreen, maximize, float, move_window, resize_window, close_window, zoom, menu). Two-finger swipes are scroll and are never mapped; a mapped two-finger pinch is taken from applications (browser pinch-to-zoom).

g2PinchOut.description: Two fingers, pinch out (one of: none, workspace, special, fullscreen, maximize, float, move_window, resize_window, close_window, zoom, menu). Two-finger swipes are scroll and are never mapped; a mapped two-finger pinch is taken from applications (browser pinch-to-zoom).
